items.title: John Fedchock interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 28, 2015
items.q: Bill Watrous’s influence is is Carl Fontana... I realized okay Bill was on some here. This is the source... I kind of put him up on a pedestal for quite a long time, really trying to get close to his way of phrasing.

ctx.x: Yeah. I remember watching in college a rare video, well before, you know YouTube wasn’t thought of, but just watching this guy play with the Prince Valiant haircut and like.

Yeah. Seemingly completely effortless when he plays. And it really knocked me out. And so I was really getting into him and Urbie. And someone said, “well you know Bill Watrous’s influence is is Carl Fontana.” So I said, “oh, who’s Carl Fontana?” And at the time Carl had no albums out under his own name. He didn’t record any albums under his own name until like 1986 or something like that. So I had to hunt for him. The first album I found was “SuperSax,” that SuperSax album that he’s featured on four or five…
Great. Here’s a guy who’s I think somewhat younger than you.
